subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Retrospectives for Testing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Retrospectives for Testing.

hook.text: The same type of bug escapes every sprint. Nobody stops to ask why the test process keeps missing it.

buildup.text: Retrospectives are the agile ceremony for reflecting on what went well and what needs to change.

discovery.text: Including testing-specific topics in retros surfaces process gaps that allow recurring defect types.

twist.text: The fix is rarely 'test more.' It's usually 'test differently' or 'test earlier in the process.'

climax.text: A retro reveals that date bugs recur because nobody tests timezone edges. A checklist item fixes it.

punchline.text: Retrospect on testing. The same bug twice is a process problem.

quiz.question: What do testing retrospectives help identify?
options: Process gaps that allow recurring bugs
